LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Url.Pista: Address of the integration bridge (e.g. http://localhost:8090). Local to this browser; never shared with players.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Token.Pista: Hidden legacy setting; the active token lives in memory for this session only.

LAGUNAK.Ajustes.DecoradoSemilla.Pista: Determines the sky, nebulae, planets and asteroid backdrop of the live map. Same value for everyone (world setting). Type your own number, or use the dice button in the scene controls for a random one.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.FiltrosEscena.Nombre: Tint the scene with the alert level (requires FXMaster)
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.FiltrosEscena.Pista: When the ship goes to yellow or red alert, tint the scene canvas as well as the screen border. Requires the FXMaster module installed and active; without it this does nothing. Warning: enabling it hands FXMaster's scene filters over to this module, replacing any you set by hand.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.GranoRetro.Nombre: Console grain over the scene (requires FXMaster)
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.GranoRetro.Pista: Adds the image noise of a 90s console to the scene canvas. Each era has its signature: the PSX is fairly dirty, the GameCube barely at all. Requires the scene tint setting to be on and the FXMaster module installed.

LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.WarpInvalido: Enter an integer warp level between 0 and 4.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.PotenciaAyuda: Distributes power per system (0–3, 1 is nominal). The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.PotenciaInvalida: Choose a valid system and power level.

LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.RefrigeranteInval: Choose a valid system and coolant level.

LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.ReparacionAutoInv: Could not compose the automatic repair order.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.EscudosAyuda: Raise or lower shields. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.EscudosInvalido: Could not compose the shields order.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.EscaneoAyuda: Orders a real scan of the selected contact. An echo may resolve to nothing if it moved out of range before the game master's confirmation. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.ObjetivoNoEncontr: That contact could not be found anymore — it may have moved out of range.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.ObjetivoArmasAyud: Locks the weapons target: loaded beams fire automatically once in arc and range. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.DispararTuboAyuda: Fires the chosen tube at the chosen contact. Nothing happens if the tube is empty or out of arc. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.ManiobraAyuda: Spends the maneuver charge, which refills on its own. With no charge the order has no effect. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.ManiobraEmpujeInv: Maneuver boost must be between 0 and 1.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.AtraqueAyuda: Undock releases a completed docking; abort stops an approach in progress. They are not the same. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.AtraqueInvalido: The docking order could not be prepared.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.FrecuenciaAyuda: Recalibrating leaves the shields down while it lasts. Picking the moment is the decision. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.FrecuenciaInvalid: Frequency must be an integer between 0 and 20.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.AutodestruccionAy: Arming does not destroy the ship: it generates three codes, one per person. It can only be disarmed before the countdown starts. The order is relayed through the game master.
LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.AutodestruccionIn: The self-destruct order could not be prepared.

LAGUNAK.Espacios.Orden.EnlaceSondaInvali: The science link could not be prepared.

LAGUNAK.Espacios.Sensores.BaseDatosAyuda: A query, not an order: nothing is requested here, only read. It is what only this station knows.

LAGUNAK.Puestos.Requisitos.SinFicha: You need an assigned character to take a station.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Requisitos.Nombre: Require ability scores to take a station
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Requisitos.Pista: When enabled, each station asks for a minimum score in one of its abilities (engineering asks for Intelligence or Wisdom, weapons for Dexterity or Strength, and so on). The GM is exempt and can always reassign anyone. It is a way to organise the table, not a hard barrier.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.RequisitosMinimo.Pista: Only applies when the above is enabled. 12 is «above average» without being a filter.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.AsistenciaRecursos.Nombr: Assistance: allow spells and class uses
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.AsistenciaRecursos.Pista: Lets the helper spend a spell slot or class use from their sheet. That is a real campaign cost, so it ships closed: without this, assistance only offers approaches that spend nothing.
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.AsistenciaNatural.Nombre: Assistance: natural 1 and 20 as fumble and critical
LAGUNAK.Ajustes.AsistenciaNatural.Pista: House rule. In 5e a natural 1 and 20 are only automatic on attack rolls, not ability checks; enable it if your table plays that way.
LAGUNAK.Asistencia.NoAplicada: The assist was no longer valid: your order went through unchanged.
LAGUNAK.Minijuegos.Ajustes.Mesa.Pista: Chips each player sits down with, and the blind values. Applies to the next hand, not the one in progress.

LAGUNAK.Ajustes.Idioma.NoCargado: The module language could not be loaded; keeping the previous one.
LAGUNAK.AndarNave.AvisoPrototipo: Ship walkthrough (#427/#540): the deck plan is the Phobos M3P's REAL interior — the thirteen rooms its model declares, nine of them holding a system — plus the cantina, which the native interior does not have. Hull rooms have a window to space. Walk up to a room's console to open the station for its system (#509).
LAGUNAK.AndarNave.VistaAlt: First-person view of the walkable ship: every room connects to its neighbours through doors in the shared walls, and each room's console opens the station for the system it houses.
LAGUNAK.AndarNave.Controles: WASD or up/down arrows to move, Q/E or left/right arrows to turn, space to jump, C to crouch, V to switch between first and third person.
LAGUNAK.Seccion.Intro: A cutaway of the ship, every room at once. Click a room to step into it.
LAGUNAK.Seccion.PlanoAlt: Cross-section of the ship: six rooms inside the hull, tinted by the damage of their region. The same information is listed below.
LAGUNAK.Cantina.SalaAlt: The ship canteen: a bulkhead with a window onto the void, the lit bar and a hanging lamp. The available tables are below, as buttons.

LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Mesa.VistaAlt: The table in 3D: the dealer at the back, face down while the table plays, and each player's row of cards growing as they hit. All the exact detail is in the text below.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Mesa.SinMesa: No dice table is open. The GM sets one up.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Mesa.RondaCancelada: The round was cancelled: the table went back to its state before the roll.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Mesa.Comodines: Ones count as any face, unless the bid is on ones.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Mesa.ApuestaInvalida: Say how many dice and which face: the bid must beat the live one.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Mesa.DestapeSostenida: There were {reales}: the bid of {cantidad} on face {cara} holds and {perdedor} loses a die.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Mesa.DestapeFarol: There were only {reales}: the bid of {cantidad} on face {cara} was a bluff and {perdedor} loses a die.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Reglas.Objetivo: Everyone rolls their dice under a cup and sees only their own. Bets are about how many dice of a given face are on the WHOLE table, counting everyone else's.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Reglas.Turno: On your turn you have two ways out: raise the bet, or call it — saying the previous bet is a lie.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Reglas.Subir: Raising means asking for more of the same face, or the same amount of a higher face. Repeating the previous bet is not allowed.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Reglas.Levantarse: Calling uncovers every cup and counts. If the bet held, you lose a die; if not, the bettor does. Whoever runs out of dice is out.
LAGUNAK.Dados.Reglas.Unos: Ones are wild and count as any face — except when the bet is on ones, where only ones count.
LAGUNAK.MapaVivo.ContactosCaidos: Contacts are unavailable: own-ship readings are still valid, but the map cannot draw what is around it.
LAGUNAK.Museo.Naturaleza.escaneo-de-vaci: Scan of a plaster cast, not of the original
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.Cancelada: The hand was cancelled. Nobody loses their bet.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.EsperandoRepar: The table is ready. Waiting for the deal.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.ManoResuelta: Hand over. Deal another whenever you like.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.TuTurno: Your turn. You have {total}: hit or stand.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.JuegaLaBanca: The dealer reveals and draws to {limite}.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.Regla.Banca: The dealer draws to {limite} and stands there, soft 17 included.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.Regla.Blackjac: Blackjack pays {pago} times the bet, rounded down.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.Regla.Doblar: You may only double on your first {cartas} cards.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.Regla.Apuesta: Flat bet of {apuesta} chips per hand. No blinds.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.NoDoblar.YaPed: You can no longer double: only the first {cartas} cards may be doubled.
LAGUNAK.Blackjack.Lectura.NoDoblar.SinFi: You cannot double: it would take {necesarias} chips and you have {tienes}.
LAGUNAK.Parlamento.Intro: Open a channel with a contact and hold a parley. Choose which part of your character approaches the problem before you know if it works.
LAGUNAK.Parlamento.EligeEnfoque: Approaches (CD and your chance of success show before you roll):
LAGUNAK.Parlamento.SinEstado: The GM adjudicates the outcome at the table. This encounter is not remembered.
LAGUNAK.Convocatoria.Elige: Choose where to bring the crew.
LAGUNAK.Convocatoria.NoSePuede: Cannot summon there: GM only, and only valid rooms.
